listing_fee.fee_basis: max(ask price, 50% of trusted reference price when reference exists)

repricing.rule: Price changes beyond ±10% charge a fresh listing fee.

reference_price.method: 7-day weighted median of completed arm's-length sales
reference_price.fallback: vendor/reference value until enough real sales exist
reference_price.anti_manipulation: Ignore self-trades, linked-account trades, wash-trade clusters and extreme low-volume outliers.

principle: Taxes discourage spam/flipping and provide a modest Gold sink; they are not the primary inflation control.
